core_claim: Audient's new iD MK3 interfaces add RoomTune monitor room correction and onboard DSP.
topic: How Audient's third-generation iD interfaces use RoomTune to measure room acoustics and adjust monitor playback, while onboard DSP handles input effects.
title: Can Your Room Trick Your Violin Mix?
hook: Your room can quietly mislead your mix.
description:
Your room can colour what you hear while mixing. Audient's third-generation iD interfaces add RoomTune monitor correction, which measures room acoustics and adjusts the signal sent to your speakers. Their onboard DSP also runs EQ, compression and reverb without using your computer's CPU. This is monitor correction and input processing, not a change to the original violin recording.

Sources:
MusicRadar: https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/this-isnt-a-spec-refresh-its-a-completely-new-technology-platform-audient-launches-next-generation-of-id-audio-interfaces-with-onboard-dsp-and-built-in-monitor-correction
Mixdown: https://mixdownmag.com.au/news/room-correction-comes-to-every-model-in-audients-redesigned-id-range/
cover_payoff: Use an original, layered 2D violin illustration with a stylised performer, animated bow movement, visible drawn strings, musical-note accents and a warm waveform payoff. This is an illustrated music moment, not a live-performance recording or a 3D asset.
narration_script: Your room can quietly mislead your mix. Audient's iD interfaces pair console-style preamps with onboard DSP. RoomTune measures room acoustics and corrects monitor playback. EQ, compression and reverb shape tone, dynamics and space. Now hear your violin through a clearer, trusted mix.

narration_evidence.quote: analogue mic preamps with onboard DSP, monitor correction and new tone-shaping tools.
It measures your room and adjusts the signal going to your monitors to compensate for its acoustics
The DSP also handles EQ, compression and reverb on the inputs with no latency and no load on your computer.

scenes.caption: YOUR ROOM CAN MISLEAD YOUR MIX
scenes.image_prompt: Full-screen portrait-native 2D vector listening room. Two large studio monitors, a clear listening position and an illustrated seated listener fill the vertical composition. Warm antique-gold sound waves travel directly to the listener and teal reflections bounce from the walls. Layered wall panels, deep perspective floor and camera push-in. Midnight navy and antique gold. Large, immediately recognisable objects.
scenes.graphic_detail: Direct and reflected sound change what reaches the listening position

scenes.caption: THE INTERFACE: PREAMPS + DSP
scenes.image_prompt: Full-screen portrait-native 2D illustration of a premium audio interface as the central hero object. Make the chassis, preamp knobs, meters and onboard processing section large and individually legible. Reveal the preamp controls first, then the digital processing display. Midnight navy, antique gold and subtle teal lighting.
scenes.graphic_detail: Console-style preamps and onboard processing share one interface

scenes.caption: ROOMTUNE: MEASURE → CORRECT
scenes.image_prompt: Full-screen portrait-native 2D visual explanation of RoomTune. A large measurement microphone sits above a vertical sequence of three readable stages: Measure, Analyse and Correct. Animated teal measurement waves enter the process; a gold signal pulse travels down the chain; studio monitors receive the corrected output. Use large icons, labels and a cinematic camera push.
scenes.graphic_detail: Measure the room, analyse its response, and correct monitor playback

scenes.caption: EQ · COMPRESSION · REVERB
scenes.image_prompt: Full-screen portrait-native 2D explainer with three large vertically stacked processing stages. Equalisation uses a clear tonal curve, compression uses a changing waveform, and reverb uses expanding echo arcs. Animate the audio signal travelling through each stage in order. The labels must be large and readable at phone size.
scenes.graphic_detail: Three processing stages shape tone, dynamics, and space

scenes.caption: HEAR THE VIOLIN. TRUST THE MIX.
scenes.image_prompt: Full-screen close-up 2D illustrated violin performance. A large amber violin, visible strings and expressive bow dominate the portrait composition. Include a stylised performer, clearly moving bow, independent arm and instrument layers, musical-note accents and a glowing waveform. Cinematic push-in and richer antique-gold light for the musical payoff. Original illustration only.
scenes.graphic_detail: A close-up violin moment brings the explanation back to music
